messages:
Liam H: quick sync — Nebula asked if we can open a marketplace SKU for eu-southwest-2 and pre-approve 40 GPU slots for first month. timeline: partner wants joint announcement in 6 weeks.
Maya P: we need legal + finance signoff before marketplace listing. i’ll loop them in but timelines tight.
Jess K: capacity question — is this Dedicated reserved or marketplace pay-as-you-go?
Liam H: marketplace payg backed by a partner entitlement (they want an initial commit so customers have soft quota). Nebula requested quota window: 40 A100-equivalent vGPUs for first 30 days, scale to 120 if demand validated.
Ana R: KMS & network ask? Nebula will use customer VPC peering and wants KMS via their tenant. we need to confirm cross-account kms policies.
Yi C: FYI sales motion: key customers in EMEA want low-latency in Madrid region; Nebula has an existing integration w/ local CSP. good fit.
Maya P: can we do a temporary SLA carveout for launch? legal might require an exhibit.
Jess K: operational checklist: 
```
- reserve 40 vGPUs (A100-optimized) in eu-southwest-2
- create marketplace SKU + entitlements
- KMS cross-account policy draft
- egress/cidr peering tests
- observability dashboard (latency + token cost)
```
Liam H: thanks. Ana, can you draft the KMS policy and a short runbook for peering tests? link to templates: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-onboard
Ana R: on it. will post a diff by EOD with the policy snippet.
Yi C: customers we want to invite to beta: Acme EU, Fathom Health, Snapline. i'll start outreach after we confirm quotas.
Maya P: finance — what’s the billing flow for marketplace entitlements? is it partner-paid commitment or we invoice Nebula?
Liam H: partner-paid commit first month; after that usage flows via CSP marketplace billing. ops will provide estimated unit economics.
Jess K: tagging ops: @deploy-bot please create a temporary quota request ticket for 40 -> 120 scale and attach to this thread.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: Q-2024-5589. ETA for allocation: 48 hours. Link: https://infra.tickets/Q-2024-5589
Ana R: KMS draft: posted snippet below.
```
resource "kms_key" "nebula_shared" {
  description = "nebula marketplace integration - restricted" 
  policy = <<POLICY
  { "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::NEBULA:role/marketplace" }, "Action": "kms:Encrypt" } ] }
  POLICY
}
```
Yi C: perf target? aiming p50 < 60ms for embeddings, p90 < 200ms for generation. can we meet that from eu-southwest-2?
Jess K: depends on networking to Nebula’s infra. we should run a simple ping / small-gen test once peering established. schedule perf window next week.
Liam H: action items I tracked: 1) Ana - KMS policy + runbook (EOD) 2) Jess - reserve GPUs & perf window (48h) 3) Maya - legal/finance loop (2 business days) 4) Yi - customer invites (after quota confirm) 5) deploy-bot - ticket Q-2024-5589.
Maya P: noted. I’ll add legal to the thread and request an exhibit template from contracts.
Ana R: posted PR for policy: https://git.internal/repos/nebula-integration/pulls/12
Liam H: great. tentative announcement date: 2024-12-15 (subject to signoffs). if any blocker surfaces, flag here. :rocket:
